models.notes: Sandstone hoodoo (mushroom rock) ~3 m tall, ~2.3 m cap width, leans slightly toward +X. Origin at ground centre of the stem.

Snow-laden conifer 9.95 m tall incl. leader (trunk to 9.2 m), 11 drooping tiers (radius up to ~2.7 m at the bottom tier, canopy starts ~1.4 m above ground). Materials: trunk, needle (tintable dark teal), snow (white caps). Collider = trunk only.
Rounded cratered boulder ~2 m wide / 1.3 m tall with 4 pebbles. Origin ground centre.
Jagged faceted spire cluster, main shard ~7 m (leans toward +X/+Y by ~1 m), 4 smaller shards, debris. Dust on up-facing facets, pale ore streaks. Origin ground centre of the main shard.

Saguaro-style ribbed cactus, 2 arms. Origin at ground (bottom-centre of trunk). Materials: skin (green), spine (cream needles, two-sided, backface culling on), flower (emissive pink). Collider offset_y = bottom of collider; center_y = collider centre (Godot axes).
Barrel-cactus cluster: central barrel, 4 pups and a short branching column. Origin at ground centre of the main barrel. Materials: skin, spine (two-sided needles), flower (emissive golden-yellow).

Dry twiggy shrub, ~1 m wide mound. Origin at ground. Leaves are single-sided quads on a double-sided material (cull off). Materials: twig (grey-brown wood), leaf (sage), leaf_dry (straw). Cheap enough for MultiMesh scatter.

Sparse dry grass tuft ~0.8 m: 15 broad two-sided blades (twisted, arching outward) + 3 seed stalks with seed heads (materials have backface culling ON; both sides modelled). Origin at ground. No collider. Cheap enough for dense MultiMesh scatter.

~9 m wide x ~6.5 m tall landmark boulder: cleaved into two halves with a dark fissure, a balanced capstone bridging the cleft, 5 flanking blocks + rubble. Slots rock, rock_dark (undersides + fissure), lichen (tintable, up-facing patches), rock_light (strata bands). Origin ground centre.

Alien skeleton ~6.5 m long (along Y; skull toward +Y = Godot -Z), ~5 m wide incl. fallen rib, rib arches ~2.7 m tall (walk-under). Origin at ground, centre of the rib cage. No collider (QA decision): the ribs are thin and the player is meant to walk under/through the rib cage; a solid bounding box would wall it off. If a collider is wanted, use a small cylinder at the skull (the -Z end) only.
Long slab outcrop ~4.4 m x 3.1 m x 1.4 m (long axis = X), leaning ledge on the +Y side, craters, pale mineral banding. Origin ground centre.
Angular grey moon rock ~3 m wide / 2.2 m tall (chiselled facets, two craters, pale mineral vein, dust on top facets) + 2 chunks. Origin ground centre.

Cluster of translucent (alpha 0.5, BLEND) hexagonal ice crystals with emissive cyan inner cores (slot core) and a snowy base with rocks. Origin at ground centre. ice shell emission strength 2.0 (exported glTF strength 2.0, halved on screen by alpha 0.5); core 5.0. ~3.1 m hero crystal.

Layered butte landmark ~18 m tall (main cliff radius ~4.3 m, talus skirt radius ~7.5 m + loose boulders out to ~10 m) with a 10 m satellite pillar at +X/-Y. Origin at ground centre of the main butte. Collider approximates the main cliff only.

Cluster of tall faceted ice spikes (hero spire 5.2 m) with stepped ledges, deep-blue lower sections (slot deep, emissive strength 2.0 = the glow; slot ice is not emissive), snow drift and rocks at the base. Opaque, flat shaded. Origin at ground centre.

Natural ice arch, 12.3 m overall width (X, incl. foot crystals; 7.8 m between leg centres), ~7.3 m tall, ~4 m deep (Z in Godot). Walk-under opening ~5 m wide x ~4.5 m high: do NOT use a single collider; legs are at x = +-3.9 m (radius ~1.7 m) if you want two cylinder colliders. Hanging icicles, snow cap, snow drifts at the feet. Origin: ground centre between the legs. Slot deep (lower leg veins) is emissive strength 2.0; slot ice is not emissive.
